name: Flat naan
summary: Flat teardrop naan bread with char spots and a pat of butter. For Indian food, curry night or bread basket scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the naan rests on y

params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~360 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in
